label: Shopify
terms_note: Tenant's own Shopify store; custom app created in the Dev Dashboard / CLI (admin-created custom apps are no longer created — registry research) with scopes write_products, write_inventory, read_orders, write_fulfillments; public apps need App Store review and expiring offline tokens; rate limits by plan (GraphQL 100–2,000 points / s; REST 2 requests / s leaky bucket); Shopify subscription + payment fees.

discovery.auth: token (custom app in the Dev Dashboard / Shopify CLI → Admin API access token; public apps via OAuth; expiring offline tokens 1 h + 90-day refresh mandatory for public apps from 2027-01-01)
sdks: official client libraries: React Router, Node.js, Ruby (shopify.dev)

official_mcp: Shopify Dev MCP (shopify.dev documents an MCP server for the Admin API schema)
rate_limits: GraphQL cost points/s: 100 Basic-tier, 200 Advanced, 1,000 Plus, 2,000 enterprise; REST Admin API legacy since 2024-10-01

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the auditor.
auth: 1. Tenant creates a custom app for its store (Dev Dashboard / CLI), grants Admin API scopes, installs → Admin API access token (or expiring offline token pair).
2. Paste into the channel vault; client sends X-Shopify-Access-Token.
3. Public-app path: OAuth authorization code / token exchange, expiring offline tokens refreshed every hour.

endpoints.purpose: product = listing (status active / draft / archived), variants with price

reference.limits: GraphQL Admin: calculated cost points per second by plan — Standard 100, Advanced 200, Plus 1,000, Enterprise 2,000; single query ≤ 1,000 points; leaky bucket with throttle status in `extensions`. REST Admin: 2 requests / s (bucket 40) → 429 + Retry-After. - Shopify API License and Terms of Use; custom apps for the merchant's own store; public apps via App Store review. - Expiring offline tokens mandatory for public apps from 2027-01-01.
